connectors.name: 喜鹊标书
connectors.description: Generate, review, revise, continue, and export Xique bid documents through a confirmation-gated workflow.
connectors.description_zh: 通过确认门禁流程生成、查看、修改、继续并导出喜鹊标书，支持完整配置卡片与大纲确认。
connectors.description_en: Generate, review, revise, continue, and export Xique bid documents through a confirmation-gated workflow.
examples_zh: 根据这份招标文件生成标书
查看并修改刚生成的大纲
确认大纲后生成正文并导出 Word
examples_en: Generate a bid document from this tender file.
Review and revise the generated outline.
Confirm the outline, generate the body, and export Word.
